title: Configuring a Default Global Log Mode

blocks.text: You can configure a default global log mode for new profiles. This saves you from having to configure the log mode for each new profile in App Profiles. You can override this setting for individual profiles in App Profiles.
To configure the default global log level:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Select OS.
From the Log Mode drop-down menu, select a mode. For a description of each log mode, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.
